item.title: Lucasfilm President Kathleen Kennedy Steps Down After 14 Years
item.description: Changes to Lucasfilm's leadership has been made as it was announced that Kathleen Kennedy will be stepping down as president.

item.title: 2019 Death of Filipino Worker Has Been Referred to Australian Federal Police for Investigation
item.description: The 2019 death of Jerwin Royupa in New South Wales has been referred to the Australian Federal Police for investigation.

item.title: X Suffers Widespread Outage as Users Report Feed and Posting Issues
item.description: X suffered a major outage Friday, leaving users across the US unable to post or load feeds.

item.title: Elon Musk Slams Ryanair Boss After Airline Rejects Starlink WiFi
item.description: Elon Musk calls Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary an "utter idiot" after the airline rejects Starlink WiFi for its fleet.

item.description: Clothing brand Fletcher Jones that it is closing down its physical stores and online business after a little over 100 years.

item.description: Microsoft delivers a fix for the Windows 11 issue that prevented PCs from shutting down after installing a security update.

item.title: Oxfam: Australian Billionaires Increased Their Wealth by $600,000/Day on Average Over Past Year

item.title: Confer Is Moxie Marlinspike's Take on Chatbots That Prioritizes Privacy Above All Else
item.description: Moxie Marlinspike's Confer is like Signal Messenger but offers an AI chatbot experience like ChatGPT that puts priority on privacy.

item.title: Tim Picton, Former Labor Strategist, Dies at 36 Following Alleged Nightclub Assault
item.description: Former Labor strategist Tim Picton has passed away at the age of 36 following an alleged nightclub assault in Perth.

item.title: Donald Trump Sends 'Board of Peace' Invitation to Different Countries—Did Australia Receive One?
item.description: Donald Trump has sent invitations to the leaders of multiple nations to be part of the so-called "Board of Peace" in Gaza.
